L=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n");cols=L[0].split();B={}
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]):B[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sc(a,b):return B.get((a,b),-4)
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1):Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a_=s1[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=sc(a_,s2[j-1]);best=max(M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1])
            M[i,j]=best+d;pM[i,j]=0 if best==M[i-1,j-1] else(1 if best==X[i-1,j-1] else 2)
            u=M[i-1,j]+go;v=X[i-1,j]+ge;X[i,j]=max(u,v);pX[i,j]=0 if u>=v else 1
            u=M[i,j-1]+go;v=Y[i,j-1]+ge;Y[i,j]=max(u,v);pY[i,j]=0 if u>=v else 2
    i,j=n,m;state=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]]));A1=[];A2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if state==0:A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;state=ns
        elif state==1:A1.append(s1[i-1]);A2.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;state=ns
        else:A1.append('-');A2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;state=ns
        if i==0 and j>0:state=2
        if j==0 and i>0:state=1
    return "".join(reversed(A1)),"".join(reversed(A2))
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
     'LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','LLP':'K','MSE':'M'}
def chain_seq(p,ch="A"):
    txt=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}.pdb",timeout=120).text
    seen={};order=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        if line.startswith(("ATOM  ","HETATM")) and line[12:16].strip()=="CA" and line[21]==ch:
            rn=line[17:20].strip()
            if rn not in AA3:continue
            k=(int(line[22:26]),line[26].strip())
            if k in seen:continue
            seen[k]=AA3[rn];order.append(k)
    return "".join(seen[k] for k in order),order

G5="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/G5EE32.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
QOFF=3049;QUERY=G5[QOFF:3460]
HACCS="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q96QU6.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

SITES={
 "1B8G":{119:("Gly-rich loop, PLP phosphate",'P'),120:("PLP phosphate",'P'),121:("Thr OG1 - PLP phosphate",'P'),
         124:("PLP phosphate",'P'),145:("re-face / phosphate",'P'),202:("phosphate + 3-OH",'P'),
         230:("Asp - pyridine N1 salt bridge",'R'),232:("si-face packing",'R'),233:("Tyr - PLP 3-OH / C4'",'R'),
         270:("PLP phosphate",'P'),272:("PLP phosphate",'P'),273:("Schiff-base Lys (internal aldimine)",'K'),
         281:("Arg - PLP phosphate",'P'),407:("Arg - substrate alpha-carboxylate (not <4A of PLP)",'S')},
 "1ARS":{107:("Gly-rich loop, PLP phosphate",'P'),108:("PLP phosphate",'P'),109:("Thr OG1 - PLP phosphate",'P'),
         140:("Trp - pyridine ring stacking",'R'),194:("phosphate + 3-OH",'P'),222:("Asp - pyridine N1 salt bridge",'R'),
         224:("si-face packing",'R'),225:("Tyr - PLP 3-OH",'R'),255:("PLP phosphate",'P'),257:("PLP phosphate",'P'),
         258:("Schiff-base Lys (internal aldimine)",'K'),266:("Arg - PLP phosphate",'P'),
         386:("Arg - substrate alpha-carboxylate (not <4A of PLP)",'S')}}
rows=[]
for pid,sites in SITES.items():
    s2,order=chain_seq(pid)
    a1,a2=nw(QUERY,s2)
    idp=100*sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x==y and x!='-')/sum(1 for x,y in zip(a1,a2) if x!='-' and y!='-')
    i=QOFF;j=0;m={}
    for c1,c2 in zip(a1,a2):
        if c1!='-':i+=1
        if c2!='-':
            j+=1;m[j]=(i if c1!='-' else None,c1,c2)
    numidx={n:k+1 for k,(n,ins) in enumerate(order) if ins==''}
    for rn,(role,cls) in sites.items():
        k=numidx.get(rn)
        if k is None:continue
        qp,qa,sa=m[k]
        rows.append(dict(ref=f"{pid} ({'apple ACC synthase' if pid=='1B8G' else 'E. coli AspAT'}, {idp:.0f}% id)",
            ref_residue=f"{sa}{rn}",role=role,cls=cls,
            T04F3_1=f"{qa}{qp}" if qp else "gap (no aligned residue)",
            status=("identical" if qp and qa==sa else ("similar" if qp and sc(qa,sa)>0 else ("gap" if not qp else "non-conservative")))))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows);df.to_csv("plp_site_table.csv",index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",250)
